s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of neurological symptoms with evidence of a posterior fossa mass
salient_findings: Mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern
key_facts: Migraines became more severe and positional over the past year
Neck pain after a motor vehicle accident
Noncontrast CT head showed a mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern
CT angiography showed displacement of the prepontine vessels without encasement
MRI showed a well-circumscribed mass in the left cerebellomedullary and premedullary cisterns
Mass was hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images
Mass exerted mass effect on the brainstem and cerebellum without surrounding edema

differentials: Papillary tumor of the pineal region
per_call: Papillary tumor of the pineal region

shortlist.label: Hemangioblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Well-circumscribed mass in the cerebellomedullary cistern, hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images, and no enhancement

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Displacement of the prepontine vessels without encasement and a well-circumscribed mass

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the cerebellomedullary cistern, which is a common location for schwannomas

shortlist.label: Ependymoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass effect on the brainstem and cerebellum without surrounding edema, which can be seen in ependymomas

shortlist.label: Chordoma
shortlist.why_kept: Location in the cerebellomedullary cistern and premedullary cisterns, which is a rare but possible location for chordomas

raw.rationale: The mass is well-circumscribed, hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images, and has no enhancement, which are characteristic features of hemangioblastoma. Additionally, the location in the cerebellomedullary cistern and the presence of a focus of susceptibility-related signal loss are also consistent with hemangioblastoma.

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: Meningiomas typically show strong enhancement on MRI, which is not seen in this case.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Schwannomas are usually associated with cranial nerves and are less likely to be found in the cerebellomedullary cistern.

rejected.label: Ependymoma
rejected.why: Ependymomas are typically found within the ventricular system or spinal cord, and are less likely to be found in the cerebellomedullary cistern.

rejected.label: Chordoma
rejected.why: Chordomas are typically found in the clivus or spheno-occipital region, and are less likely to be found in the cerebellomedullary cistern.
